capabilities: Open a local PDF at the page cited under the cursor
Convert printed pages to physical pages with a page-offset property
Read citekey, pdf and page-offset properties from reference notes
Preview the citation target before opening the PDF
Report duplicate citekeys and missing or invalid references
disambiguation: Not a citation or bibliography manager; it reads existing citations and reference notes and only jumps to a PDF page.
extras: Freemium: free v1 features, with Pro features (saved folder maps, folder-wide citation checks) planned behind a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship. After updates it opens a promotional tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat, which can be turned off in Settings. Some platforms and edge cases (iOS PDF fragments, Windows/Linux runs, encrypted PDFs) are untested.
problem: Obsidian's PDF viewer cannot use a citation's printed page number to jump straight to the right physical page, so readers must find the page by hand.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Citation page jumper that opens a vault PDF at the physical page matching the printed page in a citation like [@Lee2020, p. 44].
